I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to determine the underlying cause, have you ever experienced periods of memory loss, confusion, or changes in your personality?

Also, do you have any family members who were diagnosed with a similar neurological condition at a young age?

REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain (focus on cerebellum and brainstem).

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: Findings - Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML). Comments - T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Patient
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: No significant finding.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your MRI of the brain and cerebellum was non-specific despite your history of ataxia, have you noticed any episodes of vision loss, numbness, or weakness in your limbs? REQUEST TEST: MRI Spine with contrast. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Spine.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Spine: Findings - No significant abnormalities detected. Comments - No evidence of demyelinating lesions or compression.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative MRI results in both the brain and spine, have you noticed any involuntary tremors when you attempt to reach for objects or perform fine motor tasks? REQUEST TEST: EEG (Electroencephalogram).

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your EEG is normal and imaging is negative, have you experienced any episodes of dizziness, vertigo, or balance issues when moving your head?

REQUEST TEST: Serum Vitamin B12 and Folate levels. REQUEST TEST: CSF Analysis.

speaker: Measurement
